currentEditorialState.reason: R1.1 born System identity only. No current R1 disclosure, route or language authority has yet been admitted for those heads; projection therefore fails closed while the legacy public runtime remains unchanged.

laws.text: Projection consumes admitted state and never becomes semantic authority.
Record Birth does not imply public projection.
Only active or archived current target heads are public-projectable.
Current disclosure must be uniquely classified against the exact current target head.
Unclassified or conflicted disclosure fails closed.
Private or withheld targets are omitted from public projection.
A resolved current route and language identity is required before projection.
Route identity must resolve to the exact target head being projected.
Unknown route, unavailable head, unavailable language and route conflict remain distinct fail-closed outcomes.
Alias resolution produces redirect intent, never a duplicate canonical document projection.
Projection never performs runtime redaction or sanitization.
Sanitized disclosure means the admitted target is already the bounded public-safe form.
Metadata-only projection never includes canonical semantic payload.
R1.2 public projection DTOs contain no governance rationale, registry provenance, source locator or private evidence material.
Maturity is projected independently and never acts as an exposure gate.
Maturity uncertainty and conflict remain explicit rather than inferred away.
Projection does not use latest-wins, file-order or permissiveness to repair conflicts.
Canonical URL is derived only from a valid resolved canonical Record path.
R1.2 does not materialize disclosure Records, route bindings, language bindings or content realizations.
R1.2 performs no framework cutover, public UI mutation or deployed runtime semantic change.
